entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: A substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED where the UE is configured for eCall only mode, timers T3444 and T3445 are expired or not running, and the UE does not need to perform eCall over IMS or test calls.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: A timer that must be expired or not running for the UE to enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: A timer that must be expired or not running for the UE to enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate.

entities.name: UE configured for eCall only mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE is configured to operate in eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: PLMN selected
entities.description: Condition where a PLMN has been selected as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

entities.name: No eCall over IMS needed
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not need to perform an eCall over IMS.

entities.name: No test call needed
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not need to perform a call to a non-emergency MSISDN or URI for test or terminal reconfiguration service.

entities.name: No signalling initiation except eCall/test calls
entities.description: In the EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate, the UE shall not initiate any signalling towards the network except to originate an eCall over IMS or a test call.

relations.description: The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires the UE to be configured for eCall only mode.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires timer T3444 to be expired or not running.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires timer T3445 to be expired or not running.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires a PLMN to be selected.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires that the UE does not need to perform an eCall over IMS.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate requires that the UE does not need to perform a test call.
The EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate establishes the property that the UE shall not initiate any signalling except for eCall over IMS or test calls.
